Compendium.daggerheart-theah.features.It.name: Well-Connected
Compendium.daggerheart-theah.features.It.description:
So long as you are in a civilized place, you always know someone that can help you. Spend a Hope to mark them as a Contact: name them, note how they'll be useful, and choose one:

  • They owe you a favour, but they’ll be hard to find
  • They’ll ask for something in return
  • They’re in trouble, as always
  • You were lovers once. It’s complicated
  • You didn’t part on good terms

You can have a number of Contacts equal to your level.

Compendium.daggerheart-theah.features.It.name: The Contract
Compendium.daggerheart-theah.features.It.description:
When you take this Sorcerous Tradition, you also gain this feature for free. You made a contract with an otherworldly daemon, jailing it inside you in exchange for power and the possibility of release. You begin with 3 Favour, to a maximum of 7.

During a Rest, you may use a Downtime Action to parley with your dieva. If you do, gain Favour equal to your Charm. If you do not parley, the GM gains Fear equal to 7 minus your current Favour.

  • When your Favour reaches 7, roll Wits (15). On a failure, your Dieva seizes control briefly but to devastating effect; the GM will describes the consequences of your actions.
  • If your Favour drops to 0, your Dieva withholds its power. Until you fulfil a horrendous task it demands, you cannot regain Favour or make use of its magic.
  • If you die without the Dieva playing a direct part in the events, it escapes and is loosed upon the world.

Compendium.daggerheart-theah.features.It.name: Singular Focus
Compendium.daggerheart-theah.features.It.description:
Mark a Stress and make an attack against a target. On a success, the target becomes your Focus. Until you choose a new Focus or the next Rest, you gain the following:

  • You always know their general whereabouts
  • When you attack them, they must also mark a Stress
  • If you fail an attack against them, you may end your Focus to reroll your Duality Dice

Compendium.daggerheart-theah.features.It.name: In & Out
Compendium.daggerheart-theah.features.It.description: Spend a Hope to ask the GM for either a quick or inconspicuous way into or out of a building or structure you can see. The next roll you make that capitalizes on this information gains Advantage.

Compendium.daggerheart-theah.environment.name: The Climb - Passive
Compendium.daggerheart-theah.environment.description:
Climbing up the cliffside uses a Progress Countdown (12). It ticks down according to the following criteria when the PCs make an action roll to climb:

  • Critical Success: Tick down 3
  • Success with Hope: Tick down 2
  • Success with Fear: Tick down 1
  • Failure with Hope: No advancement
  • Failure with Fear: Tick up 1

When the countdown triggers, the party has made it to the top of the cliff.

Compendium.daggerheart-theah.environment.name: The Walkway Hungers - Action
Compendium.daggerheart-theah.environment.description: Countdown (Loop 14). Activate the countdown. When it triggers, all PCs must succeed on a Charm Reaction Roll or temporarily lose 1d4 from their highest Trait unless they mark a number of Stress equal to its value. Lost Trait points are regained if the PC critically succeeds or exits the Walkway.
